references.observed: Deep coarse-scaled olive-yellow body, dark scale centers, pale bare muzzle, dark eye/cheek area, eye-to-snout groove, dark-edged median fins and approximately five peduncle-spine rows on each side.

limitations: Original Balistoides viridescens visual study based on the inspected Derek Keats photograph. The raised trigger is an artistic pose; fine teeth and locking mechanics are simplified, and the cyclic swimming is not measured behavior.
